text:
alex_support: Hey team — customer reported that their voucher shows accepted in the UI and they got the confirmation email, but their org balance is still 0. Org: acme-staging, user: jason@acme.com. Can someone take a look? :eyes:

jason_customer: Yep, confirmed. I clicked Redeem, got the green check and email. No credits in portal or usage. Screenshot attached in thread.

alex_support: Thanks Jason. I see a grant_id in our logs: g-vchr-9f3d. UI redeem response was 200 and body was {"status":"accepted","grant_id":"g-vchr-9f3d","amount":200}. Pasting the API call we recorded:

```
POST /v1/promos/redeem
{
  "code": "ACME-TRIAL-200",
  "org_id": "acme-staging"
}
```

Response:
```
{ "status": "accepted", "grant_id": "g-vchr-9f3d", "expires_at": "2026-03-20T12:00:00Z" }
```

alex_support: But ledger shows entry state=UNAPPLIED and consumer_balance still 0. Timestamp 2026-03-15T18:02:11Z.

maria_billing: Looking. I can see the webhook to billing-worker returned 202 from claim-service at 18:02:13, but the billing-worker logs show a transient DB serialization failure when writing ledger rows: "ERROR: could not serialize access due to concurrent update". It retried once and then marked the job as failed -> set grant state to PENDING_RETRY.

sara_engineer: That matches a known window where the worker retry backoff was misconfigured after the last deploy (we only retried 1 time instead of exponent backoff). I rolled a patch to increase retries and add idempotency checks. Deploy went out at 18:21 (deploy_bot message below).

maria_billing: For this customer specifically, we can perform a manual ledger apply: run internal command to set ledger.applied=true and increment account_credit by 200. I need approval from support to proceed and customer's consent.

jason_customer: Please do, we need the credits to go through today for testing. Thanks.

alex_support: Customer consent received. Maria, please proceed. Also tagging @sara_engineer for verification after apply.

maria_billing: Doing manual apply now. Running script: `scripts/billing/apply_grant --grant g-vchr-9f3d --actor support/alex`

maria_billing: Apply result: SUCCESS. Ledger row id l-0745 created, account_credit increased by 200. Customer balance now shows 200.

sara_engineer: Verified in telemetry — consumption events, KV cache was fine. Root cause: worker retry config + a race on tenant billing profile creation for new orgs. Patch in staging and expediting prod rollout.

alex_support: Great. I'll reply to Jason with the fix and note that we escalated internally. Closing loop in UI: make sure grant state transitions from PENDING_RETRY to APPLIED.

deploy_bot: deploy service=billing-worker env=prod version=2026.03.15-rc3 initiated by sara_engineer at 2026-03-15T18:21:02Z :rocket:

alex_support: Follow-up items — (1) Engineering to confirm no other grants stuck in PENDING_RETRY, (2) Add alert on consecutive DB serialization errors in billing-worker, (3) Support playbook note for manual apply steps.

maria_billing: I'll run a small query to find PENDING_RETRY grants and open a remediation ticket.

jason_customer: Confirmed I see 200 credits now. Thanks everyone :party_parrot: 

alex_support: Thanks — marking resolved for now. If anything else pops up, reopen thread.
